# Helmetsan — Full Knowledge Base & Technical Architecture

> Helmetsan is the authoritative global motorcycle helmet intelligence database, certified safety standards index, and verified international price comparison aggregator across Amazon (US, UK, DE, JP) and authorized retailers.

---

## 1. Safety Standards Engineering Reference

### ECE 22.06 (United Nations Economic Commission for Europe)
ECE 22.06 is the most modern, comprehensive global helmet safety standard, mandatory across the European Union and recognized in over 50 countries worldwide.
- **Rotational Impact Testing:** Introduces oblique impact testing at a 45-degree angle against an abrasive anvil to measure rotational brain acceleration (the leading cause of diffuse axonal brain injury).
- **Multi-Velocity Impact Speeds:** Unlike older standards that tested only a single drop speed, ECE 22.06 tests helmets across high-velocity (8.2 m/s), low-velocity (6.0 m/s), and extra-low velocity impacts to ensure the EPS liner cushions soft falls as well as violent crashes.
- **Impact Sensor Points:** Expanded from 6 fixed points to 18 testing locations across the helmet shell.
- **Accessory Testing:** Official homologation requires that factory accessories (integrated sun visors, Bluetooth intercom housings, chin curtains) must be installed during impact testing to ensure they do not compromise structural integrity.
- **Visor Safety:** Visors must withstand a high-speed steel ball projectile test at 60 m/s (216 km/h) without shattering, detaching, or cracking into the eye port.

### DOT FMVSS 218 (United States Department of Transportation)
The legal minimum standard required for street motorcycle helmets across the United States.
- **Testing Protocol:** Uses a drop tower testing apparatus with hemispherical and flat steel anvils.
- **Peak Acceleration:** Limits peak headform acceleration to 400G, with maximum time limits above 200G and 150G.
- **Penetration Test:** Drops a 3 kg (6.6 lb) pointed steel striker from a height of 3 meters directly onto the helmet shell without penetrating to the headform.
- **Retention System:** Submits the chinstrap to progressive static tension loads up to 136 kg (300 lbs) without exceeding 1 inch of elongation.

### SNELL Memorial Foundation (M2020D / M2020R / M2025)
A voluntary, non-profit independent safety standard widely respected for severe impact criteria.
- **Dual-Standard Distinction:**
  - **M2020D:** Aligned with North American DOT velocity curves.
  - **M2020R:** Aligned with European ECE velocity curves for rotational mitigation.
- **Double Impact Testing:** Tests the exact same location on the helmet with two consecutive severe drop impacts to test extreme energy absorption durability.

### FIM Racing Homologation (FRHPhe-01 & FRHPhe-02)
Mandatory for riders competing in MotoGP, WorldSBK, Moto2, and national road racing championships.
- **Oblique Impact Certification:** Evaluates the Brain Injury Criterion (BrIC) alongside peak rotational acceleration (rad/s²).
- **Aerodynamic Spoilers:** Tested to ensure aerodynamic wings break away cleanly under crash impact without catching the pavement.

---

## 2. Head Shape Ergonomics & Fitment

Helmetsan classifies every motorcycle helmet into three anatomical skull profiles:
1. **Intermediate Oval (Majority of Riders):** Slightly longer from front-to-back than side-to-side. Found in Shoei RF-1400, AGV K6 S, and Scorpion EXO-R1 Air.
2. **Long Oval:** Noticeably longer from forehead to occiput, with narrower temple dimensions. Found in Arai Signet-X and LS2 Challenger GT.
3. **Round Oval:** Equal or nearly equal length and width, eliminating temple pressure hot spots. Found in Arai Quantum-X.

---

## 3. Shell Material Science

- **Advanced LG Polycarbonate / Thermoplastic:**
  - *Characteristics:* High impact toughness, energy absorption through controlled flexure, slightly heavier shell.
  - *Best Use:* Cost-effective commuter and entry-level helmets (e.g., Scorpion EXO-R420, HJC i10).
- **Fiberglass Composite (AIM / PB-cLc / Matrix):**
  - *Characteristics:* Woven glass fibers embedded in thermoset resin. Delivers progressive structural crush zones.
  - *Best Use:* Mid-to-premium street, touring, and adventure helmets (e.g., Shoei GT-Air 3, Arai Defiant-X).
- **Carbon Fiber & Carbon-Aramid (Kevlar):**
  - *Characteristics:* Maximum tensile modulus and stiffness-to-weight ratio. Lowest rider neck fatigue over extended highway miles.
  - *Best Use:* Professional track, superbike racing, and ultra-lightweight sport touring (e.g., AGV Pista GP RR, HJC RPHA 1N Carbon).

## 4. Key Brand Catalog Matrices

- **Shoei (Japan):**
  - *Racing:* X-Fifteen (ECE 22.06 & FIM certified, AIM+ shell).
  - *Street:* RF-1400 (Compact aerodynamics, Pinlock EVO included).
  - *Modular:* Neotec 3 (Dual P/J homologation, stainless steel micro-ratchet).
- **Arai (Japan):**
  - *Racing:* Corsair-X (PB-SNC² shell, VAS-V shield system, Snell M2020 certified).
  - *Touring:* Regent-X (Enlarged shell opening for easy on/off).
  - *Adventure:* Tour-X5 (New VAS-A shield, peak visor detachable without tools).
- **AGV (Italy):**
  - *Racing:* Pista GP RR (100% Carbon fiber shell, 5mm optical class 1 visor).
  - *Sport Touring:* K6 S (Carbon-aramid composite, ultra-light 1,255g).
- **HJC (South Korea):**
  - *Racing:* RPHA 1N (FIM homologated, PIM+ carbon-glass shell).
  - *Street:* RPHA 71 (ECE 22.06, integrated sun shield, acoustic sound isolation).
- **Scorpion EXO (USA/Europe):**
  - *Racing:* EXO-R1 Air (TCT-U composite, AirFit inflatable cheek pad system).
  - *Touring:* EXO-T520 (SpeedView drop-down visor, KwikWick II liner).

## 5. Official Data Feeds & Sitemaps
 
- **XML Sitemap Index:** `https://helmetsan.com/sitemap_index.xml`
- **Brand Sitemaps:** `https://helmetsan.com/sitemap-brands.xml` (dynamic lastmod from child helmets)
- **Comparison Sitemaps:** `https://helmetsan.com/sitemap-comparisons.xml` (all head-to-head pairings)
- **Product Images Sitemap:** `https://helmetsan.com/sitemap-helmets-images.xml` (full gallery and R2 CDN image index)
- **Helmet Model Sitemaps:** `https://helmetsan.com/helmet-sitemap.xml` through `helmet-sitemap18.xml`
- **Safety Standard Sitemaps:** `https://helmetsan.com/safety_standard-sitemap.xml`
- **Single Helmet Markdown API:** `https://helmetsan.com/helmets/{slug}/?format=md` (zero-shot LLM retrieval with Quick Answer, Verdict, and Alternatives)
- **Comparison Markdown API:** `https://helmetsan.com/comparison/?format=md&ids={slug1},{slug2}` (side-by-side spec comparison table and comparative winner analysis)
- **Shareable Comparison URLs:** `https://helmetsan.com/vs/{slugA}-vs-{slugB}/` (social-optimized canonical comparison with OpenGraph tags)
- **Embeddable Spec Cards:** `https://helmetsan.com/embed/{slug}/?theme=dark` (standalone responsive HTML spec cards for external integration)
- **Exchange Rates & Currency API:** `https://helmetsan.com/wp-json/helmetsan/v1/edge/rates`
